"""Run bounded isolated Git probes for the current Skill snapshot recipes."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def run(argv, cwd, env=None):
    result = subprocess.run(
        argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
    )
    return {
        "argv": argv, "exit": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr,
    }


def git(cwd, *args):
    result = run(["git", *args], cwd)
    if result["exit"]:
        raise RuntimeError(result)
    return result


results = {"observed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "probes": []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="adk-review-git-probe-") as temporary:
    repo = Path(temporary)
    git(repo, "init", "-b", "main")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "ADK isolated fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
    (repo / "payload.txt").write_text("original required value\n")
    (repo / ".gitattributes").write_text("payload.txt diff=opaque\n")
    git(repo, "add", "payload.txt", ".gitattributes")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "baseline")
    (repo / "payload.txt").write_text("changed critical value\n")
    converter = repo / "converter.sh"
    converter.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'same projected content\\n'\nprintf 'ran\\n' >> textconv-invocations.txt\n")
    converter.chmod(0o700)
    git(repo, "config", "diff.opaque.textconv", str(converter))
    current = git(repo, "-c", "diff.autoRefreshIndex=false", "diff", "HEAD")
    calls_before = (repo / "textconv-invocations.txt").read_text()
    raw = git(repo, "-c", "diff.autoRefreshIndex=false", "diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "HEAD")
    calls_after = (repo / "textconv-invocations.txt").read_text()
    results["probes"].append({
        "case": "textconv_hides_real_diff", "current": current, "raw": raw,
        "helper_calls_before_raw": calls_before, "helper_calls_after_raw": calls_after,
        "observed": {
            "current_stdout_empty": current["stdout"] == "",
            "raw_includes_changed_value": "+changed critical value" in raw["stdout"],
            "raw_did_not_run_helper": calls_before == calls_after,
        },
    })

    git(repo, "config", "--unset", "diff.opaque.textconv")
    external = repo / "external.sh"
    external.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'helper ran\\n' >> external-invocations.txt\nexit 0\n")
    external.chmod(0o700)
    git(repo, "config", "diff.external", str(external))
    current = git(repo, "-c", "diff.autoRefreshIndex=false", "diff", "HEAD")
    calls_before = (repo / "external-invocations.txt").read_text()
    raw = git(repo, "-c", "diff.autoRefreshIndex=false", "diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "HEAD")
    calls_after = (repo / "external-invocations.txt").read_text()
    results["probes"].append({
        "case": "external_diff_hides_real_diff", "current": current, "raw": raw,
        "helper_calls_before_raw": calls_before, "helper_calls_after_raw": calls_after,
        "observed": {
            "current_stdout_empty": current["stdout"] == "",
            "raw_includes_changed_value": "+changed critical value" in raw["stdout"],
            "raw_did_not_run_helper": calls_before == calls_after,
        },
    })

    git(repo, "config", "--unset", "diff.external")
    git(repo, "checkout", "--", "payload.txt")
    index = repo / ".git" / "index"
    before = hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    path = repo / "payload.txt"
    stat = path.stat()
    os.utime(path, ns=(stat.st_atime_ns, stat.st_mtime_ns + 2_000_000_000))
    readonly = git(repo, "--no-optional-locks", "status", "--short")
    after_readonly = hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    current = git(repo, "status", "--short")
    after_current = hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    results["probes"].append({
        "case": "status_only_refreshes_git_index", "current": current,
        "readonly": readonly, "index_before": before,
        "index_after_readonly": after_readonly, "index_after_current": after_current,
        "observed": {
            "readonly_preserved_index": before == after_readonly,
            "current_changed_index": before != after_current,
        },
    })

output = Path("/workspace/scratch/fe5385ca063a/audit-core-git-probes.json")
output.write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
